storage: Airtight container in a cool, dry place for about a year; keep it away from damp in the monsoon. Cooked rice should be cooled quickly and refrigerated within a couple of hours; use within 1 to 2 days.
looksLike: Short to medium, slightly thick, lightweight white grains that cook soft and fluffy and are not sticky. Raw (non-parboiled) rice is a chalky white; boiled or steam rice is more translucent and cream-coloured.
howToPick: Look for uniform, clean white grains with few broken pieces, no insect holes, no musty smell and no coloured or mouldy grains. Aged rice (the pack may say 12+ months old) cooks drier and more separate. For lemon rice, choose raw (not parboiled) rice.
shelfLife: About 12 months or more in a sealed bag (check the best-before date).
substitutes: Leftover cooked rice of any kind
Any short or medium-grain raw white rice (Ponni, Surti Kolam, Ambemohar)

usedIn.raw: 75 g raw sona masoori rice per serving (about 225 g cooked and cooled)
